title: Zindan se kazim ko
body:
zindan se kazim ko mili kaisi rehaai
zanjeer bhi hai tan pe hai aur saath sipahi
<<DIVIDER>>
syed ne kayi saal ruku mein hai guzaare
ro ro ke ye zindan bhi deta hai gawahi
zindan se kazim ko mili...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab koi pardes mein mar jaaye na qaidi
mayyat pe na beta hai behan aur na bhai
zindan se kazim ko mili...
<<DIVIDER>>
be gor o kafan laash thi baghdad ke pul par
lut'ti rahi be-jurm hi zehra ki kameini
zindan se kazim ko mili...
<<DIVIDER>>
paband e salasil rahi mayyat na kisi ki
ye saatve mazloom ne hai rasm nibhayi
zindan se kazim ko mili...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaate koi zanjeer to phir ghusl o kafan ho
deti rahi mayyat pe zehra ye duhaai
zindan se kazim ko mili...
<<DIVIDER>>
baghdad mein sadaat pe jo zulm huwe hai
har daur ki tareekh ye deti hai gawaahi
zindan se kazim ko mili...
